grammar.title: Comparing options with 不如
grammar.explanation: 不如 (bùrú) compares two things and says the first is not as good as the second: 这个不如那个 (this one isn't as good as that one). It can also suggest a better option: 不如我们走吧.

sentences.en: This one isn't as good as that one.

sentences.zh: 坐飞机不如坐火车方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò fēijī bùrú zuò huǒchē fāngbiàn.
sentences.en: Flying isn't as convenient as taking the train.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànyǔ bùrú tā hǎo.
sentences.en: My Chinese isn't as good as his.
How about we go again tomorrow instead.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiě de xiǎoshuō hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.en: The novel he wrote is very famous.
